mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_chat_messages (id, tenant_id, session_id, end_user_id, message_id, role, content, metadata, message_version, input_references, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{endUserId}, #{messageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{metadata,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{messageVersion}, #{references,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.chat.persistence.ChatReferencesTypeHandler}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO nw_chat_messages (id, tenant_id, session_id, end_user_id, message_id, role, content, metadata, input_references, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{sessionId}, #{endUserId}, #{messageId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{references, typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.chat.persistence.ChatReferencesTypeHandler}, '[]'::jsonb), now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, message_id) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, input_references = EXCLUDED.input_references, message_version = nw_chat_messages.message_version + CASE WHEN nw_chat_messages.content IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content OR nw_chat_messages.metadata IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.metadata OR nw_chat_messages.input_references IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.input_references THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE nw_chat_messages.session_id = EXCLUDED.session_id AND nw_chat_messages.end_user_id = EXCLUDED.end_user_id AND nw_chat_messages.role = EXCLUDED.role
